batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b LJ Wright

batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b MM Sharma

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b MM Sharma

batting.name: KW Richardson
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b CH Morris

batting.name: R Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

balls.text: of all the ways you can err while bowling a yorker, Dinda ends up bowling the worst! It's a fullish length delivery on off stump. Dhoni was waiting on the back foot and murders it with a powerful swing of the bat.. It sails over the sight screen. Monster hit..
Uthappa's mistake makes Pune pay, it's a fuller length delivery that the batsman sweeps to deep midwicket boundary

tries another one, but this one was a low full toss hit straight to long on.. They call for a second as Dinda doesn't collect it cleanly.. THere was no chance of a run there, Robin gets to it and takes an aim when he could have just run to the stumps, he misses
another yorker wide outside off, Raina can only steer it to third man
another super yorker, right on the off stump line, Dhoni brings his bat down in time to block that out to leg side
he tries to sweep the yorker wide outside off to fine leg again, but that one was quick and right on the blockhole, it sneaks under the bat
another low full toss, but this one is on off stump, the batsman drives it down the ground to long off. He keeps the strike
attempts a yorker, errs, as it is a low full toss wide outside off, Dhoni punishes it by slicing it over point
he bowls it short of length on the stumps, the batsman goes for his favourite hoick, but doesn't get any timing, it's hit straight to deep midwicket
he bowls a full toss on the stumps, the batsman flogs it down to long on, for a single
he bowls it full wide outside off, the batsman blocks it out to extra cover for a single
length delivery on the middle and leg line, Raina flicks it in the gap between short fine and backward square leg perfectly
he bowls a good yorker on off, but the batsman drives it off the toe end all the way to deep extra cover

Dinda is going to be targeted tonight! Dhoni charges down the pitch and he gets under he length delivery, after that it's only a question of how far it would go.. this one goes way over long on for a flat six
wow! It was a full delivery wide outside off and Dhoni has paddled it fine on the leg side, beating the fielder at short fine with ease
he bowls a length delivery wide outside off, the batsman punches it to deep cover off the back foot
Lucky to get away with it! The umpire thought about stretching his arms at this one was a full wide delivery outside off.. Looked fine on the replay though
he bowls a low full toss outside off, the batsman just punches it over the bowler's head and even though that was off the toe-end, it had enough legs to beat the two fielders in the deep
he bowls a full delivery outside off, the batsman slices it to deep backward point
he bowls a slower length delivery on the stumps, Raina is a touch early in his hoick, but adjusts to punch it to deep midwicket
another high full toss on the stumps, the batsman doesn't try too much, he just slices it towards point for a single
he bowls it full and on the stumps, 140 kph, Raina drives it along the ground to long off to bring up his half-century..
he bowls a slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to long on
he bowls a high full toss on the pads, Raina tries to flick but misses, gets hit on the thigh pad and they steal a leg bye
he is not waiting for the 20th over! He stays on the back foot and punches the length delivery like a boxer, it sails all the way, over the extra cover boundary! What a shot that was!
he gets and easy ball and makes full use of it! It's a back of length delivery on the pads, the batsman just helps it along its way fine on the leg side
he bowls a slower length delivery on the off stump, the batsman drives it to long off
caught at long off!  And as so often happens when Badri tries to play a lofted shot, it goes straight into the hands of the fielder
he bowls a slower delivery wide outside off, the batsman was moving outside leg and tries to stretch and get to it, but makes no contact
he bowls a slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman gets an inside edge on to the pads
he comes forward and drives a length delivery down the ground to long off for a single
he tries to bowl that back of hand slower delivery wide of the batsman, but it goes too wide, the keeper doesn't take it cleanly
he chips the length bowl and it falls a few meters short of long on

bowls a slower delivery on the stumps which the batsman sweeps in the air, he didn't get hold of it.. Suman comes charging towards it from deep square leg and does well to get his body behind it after he realised he was not going to get to it
he moves outside leg stump, the bowler follows him with a slower delivery, Badri drives it to deep midwicket for a single
bowls a slower length delivery on the stumps, the batsman has to wait for it and then he punches it to deep midwicket
he bowls a slower and full delivery wide outside off, Badri drives it to deep point
he comes down the pitch to a length delivery and bunt it on the pitch, it bounces over the bowler and mid off does well to slide and keep the batsmen to a single
be bowls length on off stump which Raina drives hard on the up down to long on
he bowls it short of length just outside off, Badri opens the face to run it down to third man for a single
he bowls a full delivery from round the stumps, the batsman drives it straight down the ground to long on
he bowls a length delivery on the pads, just what Raina needs, and the batsman swings his bat, sends it really really high, when it lands, it is just over the midwicket boundary
he bowls a yorker wide outside off, but Raina knows how to squeeze them out for runs, guides it to third man easily
full and flighted on the middle stump, he drives it to the cow corner with a wristy whip
more classical stuff from Badri. It was a flighted and full delivery outside off, he comes forward and drives it with an open face to find that gap at deep back ward point
he takes a couple of small steps down the pitch to get to the pitch of the delivery and drives it straight down the ground, past the umpire for a boundary
he goes on the back foot and whips the back of length delivery to square leg for a single
he comes down the pitch and takes the flighted delivery on the full, drives it to long off for a single
bowls it short as soon as he sees Raina charging down, the batsman steers it to fine leg for a single
he waits on the back foot and pushes the back of length delivery to long off for a single
he comes round the wicket and bowls it full, the batsman dances down the pitch and flicks it to deep midwicket. There is a direct hit and the batsman take an overthrow off the ricochet
he bowls it slow and wide outside off, the batsman stretches out and dabs it towards cover for a single
bowls a fullish delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep backward square leg
makes some room and cuts the short of length delivery to deep point
bowls a slower length delivery wide outside off, the batsman punches it straight to cover
another short delivery wide outside off, turning away too, Badri pulls it to the gap at cow corner where Wright makes a good diving save
tries another short delivery that comes on a touch quicker to the batsman, he pulls it straight to deep backward square leg
pushed through on the off stump from wide of the crease, Raina comes forward and defends to off
it's a short delivery on the pads, stayed a touch low, Raina pulls it along the ground to long leg for a couple
flatter delivery on the off stump, the batsman punches it to deep cover
he bowls a proper legspinner, it turns away after pitching and beats the outside edge as Badri looks to play a late cut
that is a Raina special! He makes room by moving outside leg, then gets down on his knees and crashes the length delivery through extra cover with lot of power and timing
walks across the stumps and pulls a shortish delivery down to deep backward square leg
another flat-batted shot to a length delivery outside off, hits it straight to long on
he waits on the back foot for a back of length delivery and wrists it away to fine leg from around off stump
he moves outside leg stump and flat bats a length delivery down to long on for a single
he bowls it short around off stump, the batsman gets under it and pulls it down to fine leg
he opens the face to steers it to third man off a length delivery

another short delivery! Has that been put down? Luke Wright has dropped it at short midwicket. Raina looked set to fall to his problem delivery, he went for the pull, got hit high on the bat and the ball lobbed towards short midwicket. Wright probably expected it to come to him, but it dipped on him. He dived forward, got his hands under it but wasn't able to hold on
bowls a quick short delivery to test Raina! But it is outside off and Raina doesn't bother getting anywhere near to it
he waits on the back foot for the slower delivery and opens the face to tickle it to third man
he stays in the crease and tries to power the full delivery down the ground, but it hits the toe-end of the bat and dribbles to long on
he bowls a length delivery on the stumps, the batsman nudges it to deep midwicket off the front foot
he comes to the front foot and drives the length delivery down the ground to long on
bowls short of length on off stump, the batsman punches it back past the bowler
he makes room by moving outside leg and slices the length delivery over point.. Sounds of 'catch it'.. but it went comfortably over
back of length delivery, stops a touch after pitching, Raina pushes it to cover off the back foot
slower delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to long on for a single
short of length delivery wide outside off, it was there to be hit, Badri punches it off the back foot, but finds Yuvraj at point
back of length delivery on the off stump, the batsman dabs it towards midwicket and calls for a quick single
back of length delivery wide outside off, Raina stays on the back foot and punches it to deep extra cover
back of length delivery, 119 kph, the batsman spot the change in pace, waits for it and steers it to third man
length delivery on the off stump, the batsman gets squared up a touch as he defends it to cover
he bowls it shortish on the stumps and the batsman swivels on his heels to pull it to deep backward square leg, Kane Richardson makes a sliding stop
he bowls it short of length on off stump, the batsman defends it to point
flighted on the pads, the batsman drives it to deep midwicket for a single
defends the flatter delivery off the front foot

he plays a premeditated sweep to a delivery that is pitched short in length around leg stump! The batsman misses as he was nowhere near the pitch of the ball, gets hit around the knee roll of his front pad.. The umpire reckons that would have flicked the leg stump
tossed up and full outside off, the batsman drives it to mid off for a single
pushed through outside off, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot
bowls a flighted delivery on the stumps, the batsman gets an inside edge fine on the leg side, short fine leg fielder slides and keeps the batsmen to a single
there was a bit of hesitation as the batsmen took that single, but the throw comes to the wrong end. Saha would have struggled at the non-strikers. It was a slower ball that was pushed to cover point
and he plays his first proper shot! A cover drive just in the right place off a length delivery

that has gone all the way! It went high and looked like it was coming down in the playing area, but it has gone to the sight screen. It was a length delivery that Saha hit over the bowler's head with a straight bat
goes for a big swing to a fuller delivery on off stump, he was aiming for long on, but gets a bottom edge to the keeper
another back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman gets an inside edge to short fine where Dinda fumbles and allows an easy single
shortish delivery angling in, 139 kph, but this one is heading down the leg side and Raina swivels to send it to the backward square leg boundary
fuller length on off stump, Raina goes for a drives, but the bat turns in his hands and he doesn't get any timing. They take a single to wide mid off
he comes forward and drives the length delivery on the up, but straight to the man at cover
keeps it just short of length, 135 kph, the batsman defends it off the back foot
angles it in from wide of the crease, the batsman tucks it to square leg for a single
he tries to go for a premeditated pull to a length delivery outside off, makes no contact
he bowls it short of length on the stumps, Raina again gets up on his toes and whips it to fine leg
back of length delivery on the body, Raina hops and guides it to fine leg
he bowls a full delivery that Raina ends up chipping just over the bowler's head, off a leading edge, he is lucky as it drops just short of mid on
he bowls it on a length round about off stump, Raina tries to push it to leg side off the back foot, gets a leading edge to the off side
he has struck off his third ball! Big one this! It was angled in from round the wicket and it just straightens a touch, enough to beat the batsman's defensive poke, then hits the offstump
back of length outside off, the batsman defends it to point off the back foot
bowls short of length delivery angling in to the batsman, he tries to turn it away to the leg side, gets hit on the thigh pad
he finishes it off with another dot ball, short of length delivery that the batsman defends.
bowls a slower delivery that cuts away after pitching, Saha hangs his bat at that and is beaten
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits on the back foot and punches it straight to point
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it to cover point off the back foot
this one holds its line, the batsman gets beaten as he plays inside the line
gets one to jag back and hits Saha right in front! It was short of length and didn't bounce that much.. Saha looked out..
flighted delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends
bowls a flatter delivery on the pads, Saha got across the stumps and gets hit on the pads, Rahul appeals, but that was sliding down the leg side
more loop, but this is on the pads, Hussey drives it to deep midwicket for a single
tossed up delivery, on a good length, the batsman pushes it to the left of the bowler, who makes a good diving save
another tossed up delivery, closer to the stumps, the batsman defends it to the off side
tossed up delivery wide outside off, it was full too, Hussey drives it square through the off side
full and slower on the stumps, the batsman drives it down the ground to long on for a single
he slogs the slower delivery, it goes really high in the air and drops short of the deep midwicket fielder..
bowls a length delivery on the pads, Dinda nudges it to midwicket for a single
that's too good for the No 10! It was a slower ball, the batsman realises it too late, ends up playing a check drive, and ends up spooning it to Raina at cover
bowls a low full toss on the leg stump, the batsman punches it to deep midwicket.. Turns down the single
he bowls a slower delivery wide outside off, the batsman walks across the stumps and flicks it to deep midwicket
tries to go inside out with a drives off a length delivery, but gets an outside edge to third man
he bowls it full and the batsman drives it hard past the bowler, long on (Hussey) comes around to field it in front of the sight screen
it's a short rising delivery, the batsman makes room and tries to go over extra cover, but he ends up pushing it up rather than forward.. Easy catch for Raina at cover
another good yorker on off stump, the batsman blocks it out towards deep cover
he bowls a length ball, the batsman slaps it to long off for a single
he bowls it full and tries to whack it over the infield, ends up slicing it over extra cover
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman makes rooms and cuts it through backward point, but Hussey, from third man, runs around and boots it in
goes for a yorker from round the wicket, it's a good one too. The batsman blocks it out towards long on
expected the short one and there it was, he upper cuts it to third man for a single
back of length delivery following the batsman, he defends it back to the bowler
another short delivery that goes over the top edge off the bat as the batsman attempts to pull it
bowls it short of length as the batsman moves outside leg, beats him with the bounce on that
pushed through on the stumps, driven down to long on
fuller and Bhuvi sends this flying over deep midwicket with a powerful slog sweep
pushed through outside off, the batsman defends it to cover
Bhuvi does it better, he slaps the length delivery over the umpire
it looked like a good hit when he charged down the pitch and whacked it over the bowler, but only went as far as long on
he bowls it short and flat on the stumps, the batsman pulls it to cow corner for  a couple
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it down the pitch
he bowls a slower delivery outside off, the batsman clears his front leg out, and drags it towards midwicket
length delivery outside off, he steers it down to third man for a single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman gets beaten as he plays inside the line
short delivery on the stumps, the batsman tries to upper cut it and sway away with closed eyes at the same time, makes no connection
bowls it down the leg side, some useful extra runs..
length delivery outside off, the batsman steers it to backward point
pushed through on the stumps, the batsman punches it down the ground to long on
slightly slower this time, the batsman again pushes it back to the bowler
this time he plays outside the line and gets beaten, the ball also beats the off stump
flatter delivery on off, defended to the off side
quicker delivery that was short too, he could have whacked it anywhere, but he gets a toe end to it and the ball lobs up gently for Jajeja to gobble that up.. Is that the end of the match?
Jajeja bowls it with a pause now, the batsman comes down the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler
tries to bowl a legspinner outside off, it was short and asking to be hit, but the batsman punches it back to the bowler
this one is full too and tossed up, the batsman clears his front leg out and launches it over the cow corner for a six
he bowls it full, was the carrom ball, but that doesn't matter as Kane gets under it and whacks it over the bowler's head
bowls it with a pause, the batsman nudges it to square leg
looks to smash it down the ground, but this one was slower, he gets an inside edge to short fine
he come down the pitch and drives the flatter delivery to long on
he comes forward and drives it to extra cover for a single
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to backward point
that was punched hard off the back foot, but Raina at cover makes a good diving save, but doesn't collect it cleanly
bowls length outside off, the batsman punches it to extra cover for a single
he makes room to a length delivery on the middle stump, punches it straight to cover
he charges down the pitch and slices the length delivery over point, but the fielder at deep point makes a good sliding save at the boundary
this one goes straight on, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot
gets this one to turn after pitching on the middle stump line, beats the bat
he goes back to a quicker delivery and pushes it back to the bowler
he stays on the back foot and punches the length delivery to deep midwicket
he punches it in the air towards extra cover, it was up for a long time, but too far from Raina at cover
bowls it flat and quick on the stumps, the batsman gets an inside edge on to his pads
he gets up on his toes to get inside the line of the shortish delivery and pushes it to deep square leg
he waits in the crease and punches the length delivery outside off to deep point
he punches the back of length delivery on off to midwicket off the back foot, straight to the fielder though
he hops on his toes and steers the back of length delivery down to third man
another short of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman nudges it to square leg for a single
the batsman stays on the back foot and defends the back of length delivery to midwicket
this one is a long-hop down the leg side, the batsman slaps it with ease to the deep backward square leg boundary
that's the carrom ball and it turned a lot.. The batsman, though, spotted it and defends it down the pitch.
pushed through on the pads, the batsman nurdles it to deep midwicket off the back foot
flatter delivery outside off, the batsman cuts it fine to third man
he comes down the pitch and defends the flighted delivery back down the pitch

another run out! What are they doing! It was a flatter delivery on off, the batsman gets an inside edge to the leg side, but the fielders appeal for lbw. Smith runs halfway down and Nayar responds to the call belatedly, but he was just too late.. Simple chance at non-striker's end
he gets a thick leading edge just to the right of midwicket of a short of a length delivery as he tries to whip this one behind square on the leg side... They take a couple to deep midwicket
he bowls another short of length delivery angling in to the left-hander from round the wicket, the batsman dabs it towards point for a single
he bowls a slower delivery on a length, the batsman comes forward, waits a touch, then drives it to deep cover
back of length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it towards cover point and calls for a quick single
he bowls it on a length and it takes an inside edge on to the pads as the batsman tries to defend
he bowls a good short delivery around off stump, the batsman tries to pull it, but is a touch late, ends up dragging it towards midwicket

a slower delivery this time, Smith drops it in front and calls for a quick single. Morkel gets to the ball, slides and picks it, takes aim at the non-stiker's end, but the batsman was quick to get to the other end.
he bowls it full on the stumps, the batsman drives it straight to Ashwin at midwicket
he comes forward and defends the length delivery towards point

oh no! This is unlucky! it was was fuller delivery on off and middle, the  batsman drives it beautifully back down the ground, but the ball hits the stumps at the other end.. Unfortunately for Wright, the ball flicked Morkel's boot along the way
there was not much width on that one, but Smith powers it with an open face through backward point for a beautiful boundary
he bowls it short of length on off stump, Smith punches it on the up to cover
he comes forward and drives the length delivery on the up to deep extra cover for a single
he walks a step down the pitch and the bowler bowls short of length into the body, cramps him for room, the batsman inside edge it on to his pads and then to third man
back of length delivery on off stump, stays a touch low, the batsman punches it down the ground to long off
back of length delivery just outside off, 135 ks, the batsman gets up on his toes and punches it straight to point
bowls a slower delivery now, short of length and on off stump, the batsman waits and nudges it to midwicket
he bowls it just short of length, 133 kph, on off stump, the batsman pushes it to cover
he bowls a sharp short delivery, 134 kph, the batsman has no problems with it as it sails over the head
he bowls it full this time! It moves away a touch too and Wright gets beaten as he plays inside the line
he bowls it from wide of the crease and on short of length, the batsman defends it towards cover
short of length on the pads, the batsman nudges it to deep square leg for a single
gets some extra bounce from short of length, the batsman steers it towards third man for a single
back of length delivery on off, the batsman defends it towards cover
he bowls it back of length on the stumps, the batsman defends it to off, where Badri allows the ball to go under his legs and gifts a single
he bowls a length delivery wide outside off, the batsman doesn't bother touching it

Smith is going to tell Yuvraj now that he should have taken that couple! He tries to slash at a length delivery outside off, no feet movement.. nothing.. just a slash.. And he gets a faint tickle to Dhoni
he bowls it full on the pads and the batsman neatly flicks it past a diving midwicket, Smith was keen for a couple, but Yuvi sends him back
back of length delivery on the stumps, angling in from round the wicket, the batsman drops it towards midwicket off the back foot for a single
he goes fuller this time and the batsman comes forward, drives it back to the bowler
bowls it short of length outside off and at 136 kph, it's never going to bother Yuvraj, he pulls it over midwicket
he bowls a slower delivery on the off stump, Smith defends it toward midwicket off the front foot
fuller length outside off, beautiful square drives through cover point! No chance for the fielders
he bowls it on a length from wide of the crease, the batsman comes forward and defends it the off side
he gets off the mark with a whippy flick off his pads, it screams along the grass

suicide! Why would you do that! The batsman defends a short of length delivery to the off side and starts moving down the pitch.. He is a bit too late to realise that he has moved too far down and that Raina was haring in.. Raina picks it up in one motion and hits the stumps direct.. Uthappa was well short..
oh that's a pacy short one to test the new man, 143 kph, Yuvraj sway out of line and it keeps going over.. Dhoni gets a hand to it, but is not able to stop that cleanly
he bowls short of length on the stumps, the batsman shuffles across and whips it to deep backward square leg

that was a good shout! It was a length delivery that came in to the batsman, Suman prods his front foot out and plays outside the line, the ball hits the pad first, then the pad, but Taufel is right to raise his finger.. That was thudding in to the off and middle stump

this time he has nicked it! It's a replay of the previous delivery, Finch tries to push at it without moving his feet, the ball just moved a touch away, catches the outside edge and Dhoni says thank you
beautiful delivery! It was on a fuller length and it moves a touch away from the batsman.. Finch was poking at it without moving his feet

short of length and wide outside off, the batsman chops it down on the ground towards backward point, it was a proper slap on that ball, it went to Bravo who fails to stop it and it runs all the way to the boundary
he comes forward to a length ball and gets an outside edge as the ball cuts away a touch, down to third man
he bowls it short of length on off stump, Uthappa pushes it to point off the front foot
how in the world is that a six! That barely got 5 meters over the ground! It was a length delivery and the batsman just drives it on the up over mid-off and that just keeps going
he bowls it full on the stumps, the batsman blocks it towards cover and calls for a quick single, Raina runs in and hits the stumps, but Robin was in
he brings it back from a length and the batsman gets hit on the pads as he tries to whip it to the on side, it rolls to short third man and the batsmen take a single
takes a couple of steps down the pitch and punches a short of length delivery to Raina at cover, who doesn't get down on time and the ball speeds to the boundary
he tries to pull a ball that is not that short! It sneaks under the bat and wasn't really far from the off stump
he bowls it short of length on off stump, the batsman gets cramped for room, defend to off
how well has that been timed! Uthappa looked like he was just chipping that quicker delivery over extra cover, but that came right of the meat and it flies over the boundary
another quick delivery on the stumps, the batsman taps it to cover
he bowls it full and Uthappa drives it straight into the hands of Hussey at mid on. It's a catch, but what's it worth? Nothing
another shortish delivery on the stumps, the batsman punches it to cover, but Jajeja has overstepped! Original Sin this is..
he pushes it through on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and defends to off
